# Photoshoot Generator

Photoshoot generator: new photos of yourself from your own photo in your MegaScenes library, with the same face in the scene and outfit you choose, for profiles, portfolios and posts.

## What it does
Pick a photo of yourself from your MegaScenes library and describe the scene and the outfit. Claude tells you the price and makes the new photos, keeping your face.

**How the files are made:** each photoshoot is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Only your own photo or one of someone who agreed, never a famous person; no swimwear or sensual shots.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install photoshoot-generator@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Photoshoot Generator talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/photoshoot/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each photoshoot uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The photoshoots show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_photoshoot_models` | Models for photoshoots with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_photoshoot_cost` | Exact price of one photoshoot before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_photoshoot` | Starts one photoshoot in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_photoshoot` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a golden hour city photoshoot from my latest MegaScenes photo"
- "Put me in a studio shoot with a blue backdrop"
- "Create a cafe portrait of me in a denim jacket"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the photoshoot (the photo you pick from your library and the scene, outfit and style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
